title: AI and Knowledge-Based Method for Rational Design of Escherichia coli Sigma70 Promoters.
authors: Xu, Kangjie; Yu, Shangyang; Wang, Kun; Tan, Yameng; Zhao, Xinyi; Liu, Song; Zhou, Jingwen; Wang, Xinglong
one_liner_zh: 该文用AI深度学习模型结合高通量筛选设计大肠杆菌Sigma70启动子，虽涉及TF-DNA启动子序列设计，但聚焦启动子工程应用，缺乏三维互作建模与结合机制研究，方法可迁移但深度有限。
abstract: Expanding sigma70 promoter libraries can support the engineering of metabolic pathways and enhance recombinant protein expression. Herein, we developed an artificial intelligence (AI) and knowledge-based method for the rational design of sigma70 promoters. Strong sigma70 promoters were identified by using high-throughput screening (HTS) with enhanced green fluorescent protein (eGFP) as a reporter gene. The features of these strong promoters were adopted to guide promoter design based on our previous reported deep learning model. In the following case study, the obtained strong promoters were used to express collagen and microbial transglutaminase (mTG), resulting in increased expression levels by 81.4% and 33.4%, respectively. Moreover, these constitutive promoters achieved soluble expression of mTG-activating protease and contributed to active mTG expression in Escherichia coli. The results suggested that the combined method may be effective for promoter engineering.
abstract_zh: 扩展sigma70启动子文库可以支持代谢途径的工程化并增强重组蛋白表达。在此，我们开发了一种基于人工智能（AI）和知识的方法，用于sigma70启动子的合理设计。通过使用增强型绿色荧光蛋白（eGFP）作为报告基因的高通量筛选（HTS），鉴定了强sigma70启动子。这些强启动子的特征被用于指导基于我们先前报道的深度学习模型的启动子设计。在随后的案例研究中，获得的强启动子被用于表达胶原蛋白和微生物转谷氨酰胺酶（mTG），分别使表达水平提高了81.4%和33.4%。此外，这些组成型启动子实现了mTG激活蛋白酶的可溶性表达，并有助于在大肠杆菌中实现活性mTG表达。结果表明，该组合方法可能对启动子工程有效。
